name: dotted-grid
title: Dotted Grid
description: Canvas 2D fullscreen dot grid that autonomously cycles through five geometric shapes (star, square, circle ring, plus, triangle). Mouse cursor creates a dark shrinking head effect and leaves a glowing blue trail that lingers and fades.

changelog.summary: Added prefers-reduced-motion support with a static canvas fallback.

props.name: mouseRadius
props.description: Sets the dark cursor influence radius.

props.name: trailLength
props.description: Limits how many cursor trail samples are kept.

props.name: trailRadius
props.description: Controls the width of the cursor trail influence.

props.name: trailFadeMs
props.description: Sets how long trail marks remain visible.

props.name: showDesktopHint
props.description: Shows or hides the desktop hint.

props.name: desktopHint
props.default: Click anywhere to change the pattern.

props.name: mobileHint
props.description: Mobile hint text shown above the touch instruction.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names for the root section.
